data.exact_reserve_text:
Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 5.6m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2023 (2022 GBP 8.8m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year reserve release of GBP 5.6m during 2023. This release was primarily driven by favourable development in Property classes, partially offset by adverse development in Legal Indemnities. No gross prior-year movement was disclosed; the reported figure is net of reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 5.6m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2023 (2022 GBP 8.8m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.

An explicit impact for claims inflation has been included within the best estimate reserves, in line with SCOR Group scenarios and Lloyd's guidelines. The overall impact across all lines of business for all underwriting years is GBP 4.2m/GBP 3.8m (gross/net) on an ultimate basis and GBP 3.6m/GBP 3.2m (gross/net) on an earned basis.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement amount was provided in the notes. The report explicitly states a net prior-year reserve release of GBP 5.6m (net of reinsurance); this net figure has been used for prior_year_development_gbp_m because no gross PYD figure was found. A gross claims development triangle appears in the notes but the PDF extraction is partially ambiguous; a best-effort triangle extraction is included below but should be treated with low confidence.
